snippet.description:

🚀 RELEASE DATE: February 10, 2026
🎁 LAUNCH DEAL: Don't miss out! Get the game with a 15% DISCOUNT during launch week!

ABOUT THE STORY: A camping trip gone wrong, a dying campfire, and eyes watching from the deep woods. Campfire: Night One will test your nerves and your patience. In this forest, silence isn't just a choice—it's your only way to survive.
